E0_baseline.description: Baseline momentum ETF rotation with 100% equity allocation across all regimes.

D2_candidate.description: Defensive cash cushion allocating 50% to defensive basket (XLP, XLU, XLV) and 50% to cash during risk-off regimes.

causal_eligibility_rule.timing: Decided strictly at Session T-1 Close (16:00:00 ET); executed at Session T Open (09:30:00 ET).
causal_eligibility_rule.collider_bias_prohibition: Conditioning on same-day negative market returns (R_{m,T} < 0) is strictly barred from primary evaluation to prevent collider bias.

metrics_specification.primary_tracking_metric: d_t = max(0, -R_{E0,t}) - max(0, -R_{D2,t}) for sessions where I_{def,t}^{causal} == 1
metrics_specification.interpretation: Purely descriptive paired downside shortfall difference. No p-values or significance tests will be used for promotion.
secondary_descriptive_metrics: Cumulative total return for E0 and D2 over full evaluation horizon
CAGR difference: Delta CAGR = CAGR(D2) - CAGR(E0)
Maximum Peak-to-Trough Drawdown for E0 and D2
Cash-drag decomposition during risk-off bull market rallies
Turnover, execution count, and modeled transaction costs (5 bps slippage)
metrics_specification.uncertainty_reporting: Descriptive confidence intervals (e.g. Wilson score, percentile bootstrap) will be reported solely as descriptive spread indicators, not confirmatory error rates.

unapproved_historical_proposals.economic_hurdle_10bps: UNAPPROVED_PROPOSAL (10 bps hurdle remains illustrative proposal only; not confirmed as required economic threshold)
unapproved_historical_proposals.cagr_guardrail_200bps: UNAPPROVED_PROPOSAL (-200 bps Delta CAGR remains unratified proposal)
unapproved_historical_proposals.horizon_252_sessions: UNAPPROVED_PROPOSAL (252 trading sessions remains proposed planning horizon)
unapproved_historical_proposals.maximum_504_sessions: UNAPPROVED_PROPOSAL (504 trading sessions remains proposed administrative ceiling)

operational_incident_and_censoring_rules.missing_observations: If market data feed drops > 3 consecutive bars, data logging is quarantined and session is flagged as MISSING_DATA.
operational_incident_and_censoring_rules.safety_stops: If single-day slippage exceeds 50 bps or portfolio weights diverge > 2%, automated circuit breaker trips and episode is logged as INFORMATIVE_CENSORING.
operational_incident_and_censoring_rules.stopping_rules: Zero interim optional stopping. No early termination upon favorable interim outcomes. No retrospective parameter tuning.
